{{MoreSources}}
{{Quote|Sir, the temperature's dropping too rapidly.|Tamizander Rey|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Temperature''' was the measure of how hot or cold an environment or object was. Temperature scales included degrees Celsius,<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref><ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> centigrade,<ref name="AoH">''[[Assault on Hoth]]''</ref> and sometimes merely degrees with no additional modifier.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 58">[[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' (1977) 58]]</ref>
